title: helianthemum chamaecistus var. berteroanum
intro: Helianthemum chamaecistus var. berteroanum, commonly known as dwarf rockrose, is a flowering plant species within the family Cistaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to support the immune system and provide relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Helianthemum chamaecistus var. berteroanum include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing and antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
